sentences.en: The couple's ______ wedding featured gold decorations and a fifty-tier cake.
sentences.zh: 這對夫妻的婚禮極盡奢華炫耀,佈滿金色裝飾,還有五十層的蛋糕。

sentences.en: He drove an ______ sports car just to impress his coworkers.
sentences.zh: 他開著一輛炫耀十足的跑車,只為了讓同事刮目相看。

sentences.en: The ______ reason for his visit was business, but he really wanted to see her.
sentences.zh: 他此行表面上的理由是公事,但其實他真正想見的是她。

sentences.en: The company's ______ goal was efficiency, though layoffs were the real motive.
sentences.zh: 這家公司表面上的目標是效率,但真正的動機其實是裁員。

words.defn_en: claiming or pretending increased importance or grandness

sentences.en: The restaurant's ______ menu described a simple salad in absurdly fancy terms.
sentences.zh: 這家餐廳自命不凡的菜單用荒謬華麗的詞彙來描述一道簡單的沙拉。

sentences.en: His ______ use of big words didn't impress anyone at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 他在會議上刻意賣弄艱深詞彙,自命不凡的樣子並沒有讓任何人印象深刻。

sentences.en: Immigration remains a ______ issue in many countries.
sentences.zh: 移民議題在許多國家仍然是個爭議不斷的問題。

sentences.en: The meeting turned ______ once budget cuts were mentioned.
sentences.zh: 一提到預算刪減,這場會議就變得爭論不休。

words.defn_en: notice taken of someone or something; careful thought or consideration:

sentences.en: The teacher demanded everyone's full ______ before continuing the lesson.
sentences.zh: 老師要求大家全神貫注,才願意繼續上課。

sentences.en: Her research finally received the ______ it deserved after years of being overlooked.
sentences.zh: 在被忽視多年後,她的研究終於得到了應有的關注。

words.defn_en: to assert something as a position in an argument; to struggle:

sentences.en: The defense continued to ______ that the evidence was insufficient.
sentences.zh: 辯方持續主張這些證據並不充分。

sentences.en: Small farms must ______ with rising costs and shrinking profit margins.
sentences.zh: 小型農場必須應付不斷上漲的成本與日益萎縮的利潤空間。

words.defn_en: a point asserted in an argument; heated disagreement:

sentences.en: Her main ______ was that the data had been misinterpreted from the start.
sentences.zh: 她的主要論點是,這些數據從一開始就被誤讀了。

sentences.en: The proposed budget cuts became a point of fierce ______ at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 這項預算刪減提案,在會議上成了激烈爭執的焦點。

sentences.en: The starving child's stomach began to ______ from malnutrition.
sentences.zh: 這名飢餓的孩子因營養不良而腹部開始腫脹。

sentences.en: The balloon continued to ______ until it finally burst.
sentences.zh: 這顆氣球持續膨脹,最終終於爆裂。

words.defn_en: to make something longer or larger; to offer:

sentences.en: The city voted to ______ the subway line further north.
sentences.zh: 這座城市投票決定將地鐵線向北延伸。

sentences.en: She decided to ______ an invitation to her old rival.
sentences.zh: 她決定向她昔日的對手發出邀請。

words.defn_en: an additional period of time; a part added to something:

sentences.en: She requested a two-day ______ on the deadline.
sentences.zh: 她申請了兩天的期限延長。

sentences.en: They built an ______ onto the back of the house.
sentences.zh: 他們在房子後方加蓋了一個延伸部分。

words.defn_en: covering a large area or scope:

sentences.en: The Art Institute of Chicago has an ______ Impressionist collection.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥藝術博物館擁有一批廣泛豐富的印象派收藏。

sentences.en: The company conducted ______ research before launching the product.
sentences.zh: 這家公司在產品上市前進行了廣泛的研究。

sentences.en: By reading the evidence, I could tell the man's actions were ______.
sentences.zh: 透過檢視證據,我看得出這名男子的行為是蓄意的。

sentences.en: Her omission of that detail seemed entirely ______.
sentences.zh: 她刻意省略那個細節,看起來完全是有意為之。

sentences.en: The villagers saw the strange red sky as a ______ of disaster.
sentences.zh: 村民們將這片異常的紅色天空視為災難的預兆。

sentences.en: The sudden silence of the birds felt like a ______ of the coming storm.
sentences.zh: 鳥兒突然的寂靜,彷彿是即將到來的暴風雨的預兆。

words.defn_en: an appearance or action intended to deceive:

sentences.en: He entered the office under the ______ of delivering a package.
sentences.zh: 他以送包裹為藉口進入了這間辦公室。

sentences.en: She dropped all ______ of politeness once the meeting ended.
sentences.zh: 會議一結束,她便放下了所有禮貌的偽裝。

words.defn_en: an attempt to impress by affecting greater importance or knowledge than one has:
words.root_note: praetendere (to claim, pretend), from Latin prae- (before) + tendere (to stretch)

sentences.en: Critics mocked the film's ______ dialogue and overwrought symbolism.
sentences.zh: 評論家嘲諷這部電影矯揉造作的對白與過度雕琢的象徵手法。

sentences.en: His ______ at the dinner party made him seem insufferable.
sentences.zh: 他在這場晚宴上自命不凡的姿態讓他顯得令人難以忍受。

words.defn_en: an inexperienced newcomer, especially unaccustomed to hardship:
words.root_note: tender, from Latin tener (soft) + foot, from Old English fot

sentences.en: As a ______ , he struggled with the basics of camping in the wilderness.
sentences.zh: 身為新手,他在荒野中連基本的露營技巧都應付得很吃力。

sentences.en: The veteran hikers teased the ______ for packing too much gear.
sentences.zh: 這些經驗豐富的健行者取笑這位新手裝備帶得太多。

sentences.en: The side effects of the medication were ______.
sentences.zh: 這種藥物的副作用是非預期的。

sentences.en: His comment had the ______ effect of upsetting several colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他的評論意外地讓好幾位同事感到不悅。
